Keyboard shortcuts

Work faster with these shortcuts. On Mac, use Cmd where Windows uses Ctrl.

Editing

ActionWindowsMac
Bold selectionCtrl+BCmd+B
Insert linkCtrl+KCmd+K
Toggle taskCtrl+EnterCmd+Enter

Moving around

  • Ctrl+P - open the quick switcher
  • Ctrl+Shift+F - search everywhere
    • Use tag: to narrow by tag
    • Use path: to narrow by folder
  • Alt+Left - go back

Notes

Shortcuts can be changed in Settings > Keys.

See also: Importing notes and the announcement post.
